newsitem.title: UK: Aston Villa shareholders back float plan.
newsitem.headline: Aston Villa shareholders back float plan.

text.p: English premier league soccer club Aston Villa took a further step towards flotation on Monday when shareholders voted in favour of the plan at an Extraordinary General Meeting.
A spokesman for the club said that the club hoped to float before the end of the soccer season in May.

The flotation is expected to value the club at between 120 and 140 million pounds and raise 15-20 million of new money. The capital will be used for the further development of Villa Park, additional commercial facilities and to provide working capital.
Birmingham-based Villa, former European champions, are currently fifth in the 20-club premier league.
